{{Quote|The vault was constructed by Toong'l Security Systems&mdash;a company in competition with Cestus Cybernetics, and known to be trustworthy. The workers were blind-shuttled to the site and never knew the location.|[[Kosta]], to [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|<ref name="TH">''[[The Hive]]''</ref>}}
'''Toong'l Security Systems''' was a large company based on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Toong'l/Legends|Toong'l]] that specialized in the production of security systems including [[Security droid/Legends|security droids]]. They were a major competitor with [[Cestus Cybernetics]] during the final [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].
